title: Add API-invariant preservation helpers
objective: Provide reusable helpers that prevent compaction, truncation, partial compaction, and session-memory compaction from splitting provider-required message structures.
implementation_scope: Implement helpers equivalent to adjustIndexToPreserveAPIInvariants for Go message types.
Preserve tool_use/tool_result pairs when selecting kept tails or truncating heads.
Preserve assistant fragments sharing the same assistant message id, including thinking blocks if represented in Go types.
Provide group-by-API-round boundaries based on assistant response identity, not human-turn heuristics.
Replace existing simple adjustForToolPairs call sites where the stronger helper applies.
out_of_scope: Do not implement partial compaction or session memory compaction in this task.
Do not alter provider normalization unless needed to add tests for helper behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Helper tests cover tool_result-at-tail, orphan tool_use, multiple assistant fragments with the same id, and assistant-first sliced histories.
Force truncate and HistorySnip use the stronger invariant preservation helper.
No API-invalid user/tool_result-first tail is produced by truncation helpers.
risks: Go message types may not currently expose assistant ids for all provider paths; document and preserve all available metadata.
Over-preserving can reduce token savings, so tests should include token-budget edge cases.
dispatch_prompt: Build reusable API-invariant preservation helpers for Go compaction and truncation, matching the TS handling of tool pairs and assistant fragments.
